object.attr: as implemented: these are the operator codes of the attribute kinds and link conditions (MELLON-EDIT-SRS); another code means a damaged file.
object.description: If a filter file's op attribute holds none of eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, between, before, after, contains, not-contains, starts-with, is-empty, is-not-empty, is-true, is-false, present and absent, Mellon shall report a load error.
